verdict.rationale: Asana's app directory documents direct integrations for Slack (turning Slack messages into tasks and comments) and GitHub (syncing pull request status to tasks, plus one-way or two-way data sync). Google Drive is never named; the only Google mention is a generic 'Google Workspace' workflow connector, so one of the three named tools is not evidenced as native. Missing for 10: explicit native Google Drive integration evidence, depth of the Slack and GitHub setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Turn ideas, work requests, and action items from Slack into trackable tasks and comments in Asana.
Automatically sync GitHub pull request status updates to Asana tasks.
Connect Asana with Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Zendesk, GitHub, GitLab, monday.com, Wrike, or another Asana project.
Create robust, scalable workflows connecting Asana with tools like Salesforce, Google Workspace, Zendesk, and more.
